data.title: Ghaf Woods
data.about:
Expanding upon the remarkable success of Tilal Al Ghaf, Majid Al Futtaim introduces its latest flagship community, Ghaf Woods Dubai. Situated adjacent to Global Village, this environmentally conscious community is hailed as Dubai’s pioneering "forest living" enclave. 

Ghaf Woods Dubai offers residents an exceptional living experience amidst a verdant forest backdrop. The properties in Ghaf Woods include 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and duplex penthouses. This groundbreaking community will also serve as a sanctuary for more than 20 bird species. It boasts a tree population exceeding its human residents and is engineered to maintain outdoor temperatures up to 5°C cooler than surrounding areas.

characteristics_module.title: Experience urban living redefined at Ghaf Woods
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• From rejuvenating spas to farm-to-table gardens, Al Ghaf Woods promises a holistic lifestyle experience unlike any other.
  • A community where residents can enjoy cleaner air, abundant greenery, and diverse birdlife.
  • Ghaf Woods has a car-free, walkable design with lots of pedestrian-friendly spaces.
  • A forest-inspired lifestyle brimming with awe-inspiring views from each unit.
  • Nature-inspired amenities like a forest-experience center, farm-to-table cuisine, and a mountain biking loop.

location_tile.title: Embrace a lifestyle harmoniously integrated with nature at Ghaf Woods!
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Set amidst the expansive landscape of Dubailand, Ghaf Woods boasts a remarkable ratio of trees to residents, creating an environment where nature thrives. Here, the outdoors offer a refreshing coolness and pristine air quality. Interconnected by forest pathways, the neighborhood offers an immersive experience, with every unit enjoying direct views of nature. Farm-to-table cuisine is at the heart of the community, enhancing the connection between residents and their environment. 

  • IMG Worlds of Adventure within walking distance
  • 08 minutes to The Villa, Residential Community
  • 09  minutes to Global Village
  • 10 minutes to Hamdan Sports Complex

more_info.answer: Properties in Ghaf Woods include apartments and duplex penthouses, providing residents with modern and elegant living spaces.
more_info.question: What types of properties are available in Ghaf Woods?

more_info.answer: Ghaf Woods offers a unique living experience where nature's embrace meets modern elegance. The community promises a holistic lifestyle experience from rejuvenating spas to farm-to-table gardens. It boasts a tree population exceeding its human residents, cleaner air, abundant greenery, and diverse birdlife. Additionally, it features a car-free, walkable design and awe-inspiring views from every unit.
more_info.question: What makes Ghaf Woods unique?

more_info.answer: Ghaf Woods offers a range of amenities including the Evergreen Fitness Center, adults and kids swimming pools, retail and restaurant options, a mountain biking trail, and a wellness center and spa.
